models.name: Bam Bam 2

The outline is exactly the same as the original model, which features a slightly wider plan shape for speed and flow, and a wider straighter tail block for drive. models.name: Bam Bam 2 Round Tail
models.description: The Bam Bam 2 round tail model is designed specifically for any surfer wanting to take their performance in solid waves to the next level. The rocker was naturally increased as we stretched, to keep the same feeling under foot as the original, as well as taking advantage of the hold given by the more streamline outline and pulled in tail. models.name: Donkey

models.name: Punt Rocka 3
models.description: Introducing the third instalment in our Punt Rocka series. The Punt Rocka 3 has been added into the range to serve as a slight step up from your everyday shortboard or its predecessor the Punt Rocka 2. The PR3 offers a slightly more pulled in outline but still carries the signature area forward as in all of the Punt Rocka models, with a touch more thickness added under the chest and also a more refined rail. models.name: Redux
models.description: A new take on an old classic, the Redux is the 2nd instalment of our most notable model yet…The Voodoo. Sharing a lot of similar characteristics, the Redux is set apart by a couple of key changes. Created with a slightly wider middle point allowing for more stability through those flatter sections. This wide point is accentuated with a newly pulled in tail area, a design that we have not used for quite some time being a flyer to deep swallow tail. These characteristics combine to create a stable board through the flatter faced sections, but an insanely responsive and secure feel in those tight pockets. models.name: Sangria
models.description: The Sangria is our interpretation of a playful Mid-length adaptable enough to be surfed in most conditions. The Sangria has a very smooth gradual rocker with a rolled Vee in the nose transitioning quickly back towards a very slight single in the middle flowing seamlessly into Vee with double concave (or spiral vee) that gradually gets more aggressive towards the tail. This gives the Sangria an incredible responsive feel off the tail with plenty of spice and drive. The Sangria draws beautiful lines and trims effortlessly making this model such a joy to ride. models.name: Second Cousin
models.description: I have worked on reviving one of my best performing Summer model’s to date, “The Step Cousin”, and adding in some key elements of one of my all-time favourite small wave boards, “The Boxsta”. We welcome to the family, “The Second Cousin”. The Second Cousin has slightly less curve in the rocker throughout the tail and a wider mid-point which then carries the added width subtly out the tail. The added width matched with the flatter rocker enhances the speed and glide feel of the board, the result making a more effortless ride while not sacrificing performance. models.name: Serpent

Although trimmed down in key areas to create an all round high performance board for those surfers chasing a bit more bite and hold in punchy pockets. models.name: Sloth
models.description: The Sloth brings with it an unrivalled ability to carry speed from section to section without a hint of drag, allowing the natural Twin fin flow to really come to life. Featuring a slight single concave under the front foot to single double concave and into a heavy vee out of the tail. A flatter deck roll with soft boxy rails and a full retro outline. The Sloth is a refined modern version of the classic old-school twin-fin, built for ripping in crummy Summer waves. The Sloth paddles easily has lots of flow in flat sections but is incredibly responsive off the tail. The Sloth can be ridden as a straight twin or also as a twin with a trailer option. models.name: Zippo
models.description: The Zippo was specifically developed for Taj Burrow and the Surfing Life Tech board test. Pure and simply the Zippo was built for high performance surfing in mind. Based of Taj’s ideal day-to-day shortboard specs, The Zippo is performance oriented but forgiving enough for all surfers to excel with it under their feet. The Zippo features a combination of the best, most effective characteristics from two of our original favourite high-performance shapes (The Donny and The Grinder). The nose entry is medium to lower for performance design, with a slightly pulled in tail that features an increased tail rocker. This results in a lively, responsive board that favours critical rail-to-rail surfing

models.name: Zippo Round Tail
models.description: The Zippo rounded pin is an extension of the Zippo model. We wanted to offer something a little more tuned up for when the waves are firing. Taking key features from the boards that made Wade Carmichael’s 2018 Hawaiian leg so damaging, we decided to combine these features creating an unrivalled performance board, built for pumping waves. This model caters to a huge variety of surfers looking for a board that handles good to excellent waves at home or on your surf trip. In addition to the Zippo’s signature medium entry rocker, and added tail lift, we have adjusted the rail thickness, making it lower for increased bite, hold and drive.
